Olivia: Quick FYI — final sweep before RC cutover in ~3h. Code freeze goes into effect at +3:00. If you absolutely need a late merge, follow the exception process and ping @Kevin with a short risk note. Any blockers?
Kevin: Heads-up — working on PR #5112 (quant batching/kernel tweak). Tests are failing on ci-gpu, but I can get a fix up within the hour. Can we request an exception if canary looks good? :pray:
Sanjay: What exactly does the PR touch? runtime allocator or model code?
Kevin: Runtime kernel and a tiny change to kv-cache handling. No model changes. Risk: medium if it regresses allocation paths.
Maya: If it touches the alloc table I'd prefer a canary on staging before allowing prod merge. Hotpatch after cut also ok if we can't get a clean canary.
Olivia: Agreed — priority is stability. @sre-oncall can you reserve a GPU for a short canary window? We can gate exception until canary passes.
release-bot: Branch created: release/v1.9.0-rc by Olivia — protected branch rules enabled.
sre-oncall: Reserved p4-16 for a 45m canary window starting at 1880015600 (UTC). Please confirm start time and provide canary checklist when ready.
Kevin: I'll aim to start canary deploy ~1880013800, run the perf smoke + unit suite, then report back. I'll paste results and a changelog blurb: "runtime: reduce quant batching overhead (PR #5112)".
Olivia: Perfect. If canary passes we can approve a late-merge exception and include a short rollback plan in the PR description. If it fails, we hold and plan a hotpatch post-cut.
Kevin: Understood. I'll also add a quick rollback script and a monitor alert for increased tail latency. Link to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5112
Maya: Minor ask — can you add a single-line changelog entry under "performance" and tag @SRE for the alert?
Kevin: Done — added changelog line and alert tag. Will update when canary completes. :eyes:
Olivia: Thanks all — keeping this tight. If anyone else intends to merge late, speak up now so we can coordinate exceptions.
Sanjay: Not planning any merges. Good plan.
Kevin: Canary started (will post results shortly).
release-bot: Reminder: Code freeze scheduled in 2h 45m. Follow exception procedure: /release exceptions on the handbook.
Olivia: Noted. Everyone please avoid non-critical changes in the RC branch.
(automated) sre-oncall: Canary window active at 1880015600 — p4-16 reserved. Ping when you start deployment.
__notes: This file is a synthetic Slack thread for release coordination. Messages are chronological and concise, matching the agents.md schema (no title field).
